text:
Nina (Eng Manager): New hire (platform infra) starts next Monday. Can someone share a compact manager-facing onboarding checklist I can paste and modify? Need prestart actions, day-by-day week1 flow, and a short 30/60/90 sketch focused on measurable outcomes. Also who to message for access/equipment.
Becky (People Ops): Hi @Nina  here's a pared-down, copy/paste-ready checklist. Ill also create the calendar templates and Slack intro.
Becky (People Ops): PRE-START (2-3 days before):
- Confirm shipping address & OS preference with IT.
- Provision SSO & email; add to team Slack channels.
- Assign buddy + prebook first-week pairing times.
- Share reading pack (arch overview + runbooks) and first-week agenda.
Becky (People Ops): WEEK 1 (day-by-day):
Mon: Quick team welcome (15m), 1:1 expectations (30-45m), IT/dev env kickoff (30m).
Tue: Dev env pair session (1.5h) + security training (30m).
Wed: Runbooks + incident playbook walk (1h), small safe onboarding task pairing (1h).
Thu: 30/60/90 draft meeting (30m), cross-functional intros (30m).
Fri: Demo onboarding task, feedback 1:1, confirm training checklist completed.
Becky (People Ops): 30/60/90 template (metrics-oriented):
- 30d: "Environment and access complete; ship 2 small fixes or tests; finish required trainings."
- 60d: "Own an infra component; deliver plan to reduce job startup latency or cost by a measurable amount; take on oncall shadowing."
- 90d: "Ship a measurable improvement (latency/cost/reliability) and present a roadmap for next quarter; mentor a teammate."
Becky (People Ops): Manager tips: reserve headspace (block 3 hrs/wk), schedule short daily async touchpoints first week, pick a clear first small project that yields a visible win.
Nina (Eng Manager): Who do I message for GitHub/org, Jira, and cloud project access?
Felix (IT): Ping me (felix@) with the new hire email and exact team/org names. Example ticket body to paste into the portal:
```
Title: Onboarding access for new hire <name>
Body: Start date <date>. Needs: GitHub org: redwood-inference (team: inference-runtime), Jira group: inference-eng, GCP dev access to project redwood-dev. Please provision SSH key and add to Slack channels.
Priority: High (onboarding)
```
Omar (HR): I will send benefits & payroll links. Reminder: complete tax/I-9 forms before day 7. I can book benefits intro in week 1 if they want.
Rohit (Buddy): Happy to be buddy. I can run the env pairing Tue afternoon and leave open office hours Wed/Thu. I'll seed a tiny issue they can complete in week1.
onboard-bot: Created shared folder and calendar templates: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/manager-playbook  30-60-90 template attached.
Nina (Eng Manager): Any recommended reading for runtime/inference infra?
Becky (People Ops): Share these: /learning/serving-runtime, /runbooks/kv-cache, /docs/observability-cost-controls. I'll add them to the welcome packet.
Felix (IT): Also confirm whether they need a dongle kit or just USB-C plus any VPN hardware token.
Nina (Eng Manager): Confirming dongle + VPN token. Sending shipping address now.
Omar (HR): Sample Slack intro for day 1 you can copy:
"Please welcome Taylor Lee, joining as Senior Platform Engineer on the Inference team. Taylor will focus on reducing job startup time and improving reliability. Say hi and share your favorite onboarding tips!"
Becky (People Ops): Quick calendar invite snippets you can copy:
```
Invite: "Welcome + Team Intro"
When: Mon 10:00-10:30
Attendees: newhire, manager, team, buddy
Agenda: intros, role expectations, first-week plan
```
```
Invite: "Dev env pairing"
When: Tue 14:00-15:30
Attendees: newhire, buddy, IT
Agenda: laptop imaging, SSH/gcloud keys, run tests
```
Nina (Eng Manager): This is great  exactly what I needed. Thanks all.
